notes.title: 1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fix a visual issue with some 3D textures in the bunker.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Cut the reload time in half.
[/list]

[b]Additions: [/b]

[list]
[*] You can now hold DOWN to force reload.
[*] "Are you sure?" confirmation message to help you not lose your saved game.
[/list]
